positive_findings: The three fixed peculiar-velocity moment components reproduce the exact Stage-74 x-direction q_y residual map within the frozen closure guard.
Every interior face was retained with separate conservative contributions to the left and right target cells.
The exact Stage-67 distributions were used without a cavity solver rerun or operator substitution.
negative_findings: The face-pair post-cancellation magnitude is only 1.1885377930165813e-05 of the pre-cancellation magnitude, so the large target-cell contributions nearly cancel conservatively across each shared face.
Large pre-cancellation face contributions are not a sensitivity measure and do not predict the q_av response of a converged modified solver.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and was not extended across Knudsen number.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned.

next_stage.name: Local Velocity-Frame Jump Audit
next_stage.scope: Using the exact Stage-67 distributions and Stage-75 face maps, reconstruct the small non-cancelling face-pair remainder analytically from jumps in the neighboring cells' local peculiar-velocity frames, quantify u-jump, v-jump, and nonlinear cross terms, and compare that remainder with the full frozen cell residual before any solver experiment.
